description: This PHP source file defines the AccountsQuickCreate class, which extends the QuickCreate class. It handles the process for creating new account entries via an AJAX-enabled quick creation form in the SuiteCRM application, setting up necessary scripts and form handling logic.

classes.name: AccountsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class extending QuickCreate to facilitate quick creation of accounts with AJAX support within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the process of setting up the quick create form, including AJAX handling, JavaScript setup, and assigning necessary scripts for the Accounts module.
